_README: Copy this to ~/.dast-ai/sites.json and define YOUR targets' product groups. A 'site' is one product that spans several domains/subdomains (admin console, SSO/identity host, add-in hosts, API hosts) which share login/sub-apps. Frieren's learned stores (app_knowledge, login_journal, transport_capability, activation recipes) key off the site id, so a learning on one subdomain is reused by its siblings and isolated from other products. It is target-specific topology, so it is NEVER committed (the repo ships only this generic example). Each 'domains' entry is an exact host or a wildcard suffix '*.sub.example.com' (matches subdomains of sub.example.com, not the bare host). Most specific (longest) pattern wins. With no local file, every host is its own key (per-host, as before).
